base_dir.description: Base directory that this plugin may access. Only paths within this directory are allowed.

max_bytes.description: Maximum bytes to read from any single file.

allowed_extensions.description: Optional allowlist of file extensions (e.g. ['.md', '.txt']). If unset/empty, all extensions are allowed.

deny_patterns.description: Optional list of substrings that are rejected if present in the requested path (defense-in-depth).
